entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Sri Achyuta Nand Pandey, Advocate, for revisionist and learned A.G.A. for State are present.

2.  This criminal revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 29.07.1985 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Varanasi in Criminal Case No. 2642 of 1982 convicting the revisionist under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentencing him to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs.
1000/-.
Thereagainst accused-revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 205 of 1985 which has been dismissed by 1st Additional District and Sessions Judge, Varanasi vide judgment and order dated 29.10.1988.

entities.text: 1st Additional District and Sessions Judge, Varanasi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for revisionist confined his argument only to the question of imprisonment stating that considering the advance age of revisionist, the sentence of imprisonment may be reduced to the period already undergone.

Munnu vs State And Others on 12 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22683233/
1 4.
However, I find no force in the submission.
5. The revisionist has not shown that punishment, awarded by Court below, is unjust, arbitrary or otherwise illegal.

On the contrary, I find that minimum punishment prescribed under Statute has been awarded, and hence the same cannot be reduced as held by Apex Court recent in State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Vikram Das (2019) 4 SCC 125 observing as under:
?? where minimum sentence is provided for, the Court cannot impose less than the minimum sentence.?
6.

entities.text: State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Vikram Das (2019) 4 SCC 125
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of above, I find no reason to interfere on this score.
7. No other point has been argued.
8. The revision lacks merits.
Dismissed.
9. The revisionist Munna is on bail.
His bail bonds and surety bonds are cancelled.
The Chief Judicial Magistrate, Varanasi shall cause him to be arrested and lodged in jail to serve out sentence passed against him.
The compliance shall be reported within two months.
10. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.
